text.p: GalaGen Inc and Lifeway Foods Inc said Wednesday they will collaborate on a new functional food and dietary supplement product line targeting consumer and healthcare markets.
Under the agreement, the companies will share core technologies in product development. The new dairy-based products will initially target elderly, pediatric, and health conscious consumers.
Lifeway, which makes the cultured milk beverage kefir, will develop natural products for the consumer market. Lifeway will manufacture the product line.

"We are in the process of significantly increasing our production capacity to meet the needs of products that we are developing through this collaboration," said Michael Smolyansky, president and chief executive of Lifeway.
GalaGen, a biopharmaceutical company, is developing nutritional products for the healthcare community and will provide clinical development support to the venture.
